nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Fill these once. igUserId / fbPageId = the STUDIO's own accounts, used for internal posts and for clients without accounts on their client file. supabaseBucket must be a PUBLIC bucket.

nodes.name: Fetch publishing queue
nodes.notes: GET /api/editorial/queue on the tracker → { jobs: [...] }, one job per (post, platform) due now.

nodes.name: Download from Google Drive
nodes.notes: The n8n Google account must be able to read the file (shared with it, or the file's owner).

nodes.name: Route by platform
nodes.notes: Matches the platform NAME as typed in the tracker (case-insensitive): Instagram, Facebook, YouTube. Anything else (e.g. TikTok) is reported back as unsupported.

nodes.name: Write caption (Gemini)
nodes.notes: Prompt is in French but writes in the client's language. Attach your Google Gemini credential on the model node below (the one n8n's assistant created works too).

nodes.name: Merge caption paths
nodes.notes: Both paths end here with the same shape: job + caption + binary.

nodes.name: Upload to Supabase Storage
nodes.notes: Meta needs a public, direct URL. Upsert by post id → re-runs overwrite the same object.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json.isVideo ? { media_type: 'REELS', video_url: $json.mediaPublicUrl, caption: $json.caption } : { image_url: $json.mediaPublicUrl, caption: $json.caption }) }}

nodes.name: IG: create container
nodes.notes: Images: image_url. Videos: published as Reels (video_url). Returns a container id that must finish processing before publishing.

nodes.name: IG: give up?
nodes.notes: Loops back to the wait while IN_PROGRESS, up to ~15 × 20 s = 5 min.

nodes.name: FB: page token
nodes.notes: One Meta credential (user or system-user token with access to every client Page) → this Page's own token for the publish call.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($('Public media URL').item.json.isVideo ? { file_url: $('Public media URL').item.json.mediaPublicUrl, description: $('Public media URL').item.json.caption } : { url: $('Public media URL').item.json.mediaPublicUrl, message: $('Public media URL').item.json.caption }) }}

nodes.name: FB: publish
nodes.notes: Photo → /photos (url, message). Video → /videos (file_url, description). Uses the Page token from the previous node.

nodes.name: YT: which channel?
nodes.notes: The client's « YouTube · chaîne » value in the tracker must equal one of these keys. Rename a key here and on the client file together; add a rule + a copy of an upload node for a 4th channel.

nodes.name: YT: upload (studio)
nodes.notes: One Google sign-in per channel: pick that channel's YouTube credential here. Vertical videos under 60 s become Shorts.

parameters.content:
## The One — social publisher
Every 15 min: tracker queue → Google Drive → Supabase re-host → Instagram / Facebook / YouTube → result back to the tracker.

**Before activating**
1. Fill **Config** (tracker URL, IG business id, FB page id, Supabase URL + public bucket).
2. Credentials: Tracker bearer (= AUTOMATION_SECRET), Google Drive OAuth2, Supabase header auth (`Authorization: Bearer <service_role key>`), Meta Page token (Facebook Graph API credential), YouTube OAuth2.
3. In the tracker, a post publishes when it has a date, platforms and a **media link**. Tick « Légende rédigée par l'IA » to have Gemini write the caption from the description.
4. Per-client accounts: fill Instagram id / Facebook Page id / YouTube channel key on each client file. Empty → the studio's accounts from Config. The Meta credential must have access to every client Page (Business Manager).

Platform names in the tracker must be *Instagram*, *Facebook*, *YouTube* (case-insensitive). TikTok is reported as unsupported.
